title: Plate to plant is one continuous problem. PharmaThe software has never treated it that way.
summary: Read the latest news and updates from ReactWise about AI-driven chemistry and process optimization.
body_markdown:
Plate to plant is one continuous problem. PharmaThe software has never treated it that way.


A molecule gets screened in discovery, optimized in process development, and modeled for scale-up.


Three stages, usually three sets of tools, and a handover between each one where data gets re-entered, reformatted, or quietly lost. By the time a process reaches scale-up, the reasoning behind the early decisions is gone.


@ReactWise covers all three stages, so the handovers happen inside one system instead of between three.


HTE Designer covers discovery screening and process plate design, through to worklists your liquid handler can run.


MemoryBO optimizes the process as new objectives come into play, drawing on your earlier HTE campaigns rather than starting cold.


Kinetics360 builds first-principles models you can interrogate, fit parameters to, and run what-if scenarios against before anything leaves the lab.


What actually makes it one platform is underneath: a shared data layer, so every stage starts from what the last one learned instead of from a spreadsheet someone exported.
